sources.title: The Llama 4 herd: The beginning of a new era of natively multimodal AI innovation
sources.evidence: April 5, 2025 launch makes Scout and Maverick weights available. Maverick has nominal 400B total and 17B active parameters; alternating dense/MoE layers, 128 routed experts plus one shared expert, routing each token to one routed expert and the shared expert. Native multimodality uses early fusion and a MetaCLIP-based vision encoder. Arena results are explicitly for an experimental chat version.

sources.title: Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct official checkpoint and model card
sources.evidence: Exact non-FP8 Instruct checkpoint. Maverick table specifies 17B activated/400B total, multilingual text and image inputs, multilingual text/code outputs, and rounded 1M context. Model developer Meta; April 5, 2025 release; custom Llama 4 Community License.

sources.title: Official Llama 4 model card
sources.evidence: Public model card identifies autoregressive MoE with early fusion, explicitly labels Maverick 17B activated and 400B total, states April 5, 2025 release and text/image-to-text/code modalities, and describes assistant chat and visual reasoning uses.

sources.title: Official model SKU types and exact sequence limits
sources.evidence: Current public source read from main; latest file commit is 0e0b8c519242d5833d8c11bffc1232b77ad7f301. CoreModelId llama4_maverick_17b_128e_instruct maps specifically to max_seq_length 1048576; base Maverick separately maps to 262144. Default checkpoint format is BF16.

sources.title: Official Llama model SKU registry
sources.evidence: llama4_instruct_models lists meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct separately from the -FP8 checkpoint, which has fp8_mixed quantization and variant fp8. Both belong to the exact Maverick Instruct core SKU.

sources.title: Official Llama 4 prompt formats
sources.evidence: Complete prompt documentation specifies text and multi-image conversations and zero-shot function calls with native multiple/parallel tool-call outputs. It documents no separate thinking mode, reasoning channel, or thinking-budget control.

sources.title: Llama 4 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Named license with April 5, 2025 effective date grants limited rights to use, reproduce, distribute and modify Llama materials under its terms; it is a custom community license, not an unrestricted open-source license.

sources.title: Public metadata for the exact BF16 Maverick Instruct checkpoint
sources.evidence: Revision 73d14711bcc77c16df3470856949c3764056b617, last modified 2025-05-22. Reports manually gated access, Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, and 401583781376 BF16 safetensors elements. The exposed chat template handles text, images and tool calls without a dedicated thinking channel. The element aggregate is not independently reconciled with tensor shapes, tying, and buffers and is not substituted for the developer nominal count.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration (gated)
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401; no attempt was made to bypass the gate and no weight shards were downloaded.

name.note: The catalog display name is an accurate abbreviation of the official Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct identifier. The 17B refers to active parameters; the target is the standard Instruct checkpoint, not FP8 or experimental arena chat.

developer.note: The developer is explicitly identified as Meta.

family.note: Member of the Llama 4 series within the catalog’s Llama family grouping.

release_date.note: Official launch announces same-day weight availability and the model card explicitly gives April 5, 2025; later checkpoint modification or hosting dates are not release dates.

open_weights.note: Official weights are distributed subject to the custom license and access gate. Open weights does not imply an OSI-approved license.

license.note: Official custom Llama 4 Community License Agreement; baseline label is accurate.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total in billions, not 17B and not an exact independently reconciled count. Public BF16 metadata reports 401583781376 stored elements, but shape/tying/buffer reconciliation was not possible through gated config/weights; retain the original nominal 400B rather than assert an exact count.

active_parameters_b.note: Explicit nominal developer active count in billions. Each MoE layer sends a token to the shared expert and one of 128 routed experts; 17B is not the full model size.

architecture.note: Autoregressive early-fusion multimodal MoE. Alternating dense and MoE layers; 128 routed experts plus one shared expert per MoE layer, with top-1 routed selection. Text and vision tokens share a backbone, with a MetaCLIP-based vision encoder.

context_window.note: Official exact Instruct SKU max_seq_length is 1048576 tokens, refining the model card’s rounded 1M. The base SKU’s 262144 limit and provider-specific caps do not apply to this record.

modalities.note: Model card explicitly lists multilingual text and image inputs and text/code output; code is text. Video-frame training does not establish a separate native video input interface.

reasoning.note: The card advertises general and visual reasoning ability, but neither the complete official prompt specification nor the exact public chat template discloses a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode. Primary-source searches did not yield an explicit exact-Maverick negative capability statement; clear the categorical false baseline instead of treating absence of mode documentation as proof.

tool_call.note: Official prompt specification explicitly supports native multiple and parallel function calls; the exact checkpoint chat template accepts tools and serializes tool calls and responses.

description.value: Meta’s instruction-tuned multimodal MoE model with nominal 400B total and 17B active parameters, 128 routed experts, text and image input, and native tool calling.
description.note: Replace vague performance/serving claims with supported nominal size, expert structure, modalities, and tool capability; do not attribute experimental arena-chat results to the released Instruct weights.

patch.description: Meta’s instruction-tuned multimodal MoE model with nominal 400B total and 17B active parameters, 128 routed experts, text and image input, and native tool calling.
patch.notes: Meta reports nominal 400B total and 17B active parameters. Maverick alternates dense and MoE layers; each MoE layer uses 128 routed experts plus a shared expert and activates one routed expert per token. The standard BF16 Instruct checkpoint is distinct from its FP8 packaging and the experimental arena-chat model. Exact Instruct context is 1,048,576 tokens. Dedicated thinking-mode support is not explicitly disclosed in the reviewed native interface documentation.

Official Llama 4 prompt and tool formats

summary: Confirmed nominal 400B total / 17B active, native multimodal autoregressive MoE with 128 routed experts plus a shared expert and top-1 routing, April 5, 2025 release, gated open weights and custom license, text/image input, text output, and native parallel tool calls. Correct context from rounded 1000000 to exact 1048576 and replace the vague description. Clear reasoning:false to null because a separate native thinking mode is not explicitly disclosed. Keep nominal counts rather than promote un-reconciled BF16 storage metadata to an exact learned-parameter count.
